caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, monochrome rendering of a lidded urn or trophy at the center of the composition. The urn stands on a pedestal with a square base. Its body is tall and gently tapered, with a decorative oval frame containing the intertwined initials "CG" on the front, surrounded by ornamental foliage and symmetrical designs. The lid is domed, topped with a pineapple-shaped finial, and features two small handles curling outward at the base of the finial. The urn is shaded to suggest a metallic or ceramic surface. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset diagram showing the urn in outline, with dimensions marked. The background is plain, and the drawing appears to be executed in graphite or ink on an off-white paper, with a rectangular border enclosing the main subject. There are minor brownish spots on the paper, and the artist's signature "M. Monginacotti" is located at the lower right inside the main border.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
